android.desc: StandBy Mode brings the iOS StandBy screen to Android: an always on display (AOD) desk clock and night clock with widgets, shown while your phone, tablet or foldable charges. Next to the clock you can show your music, calendar, weather and more, large enough to read from across the room. Choose from more than 100 clock faces, put two, three or four widgets side by side, and set the app to open by itself when you plug in the charger. Full screen clocks Digital clock with date, segmented LCD clock, flip clock, neon clock, analog clock with digital time, solar clock, Matrix, pixel art, word clock, Roman numerals, world clock and a big Pixel-style crop clock. Each one lets you change colors, fonts and sizes, so the same app works as a bedside clock or as a desk clock in a home office. The dementia clock shows the full date, the day of the week and the time of day (morning, afternoon, night) in large text. Always on display and night mode The AMOLED clock shows white digits on pure black, which makes it a good night clock: you can check the time without lighting up the room. Night Mode dims the screen and tints it red, on a schedule or with the light sensor, and you can set a separate brightness for day and night. Pixel shifting helps protect OLED screens from burn-in, and a sleep timer can turn the screen off after a set time. Starts and stops on its own Open the app when you plug in, only on wireless charging, only on Wi-Fi, only when the screen is off, or on a schedule. It can appear over the lock screen and close again when you unplug, and it also works as the Android screensaver, so the clock shows up when the device is docked or idle. The charging screen shows the battery level and how long until it is full. Widgets side by side In the Duo layout, the most used widgets are the digital clock, the music player, the calendar and the System Dashboard, which shows battery and storage. There are also analog and AMOLED clocks, battery widgets in several styles, weather, photos, quotes, GIFs, a to-do list, timers and any widget from the apps on your home screen. Small complications on the edges of any screen add the next alarm, the date, battery or progress through the year. The widget rotator can cycle through your favorites. Music player with lyrics Control Spotify, YouTube Music, Apple Music, Deezer and other apps from a music widget or a full screen player that shows the lyrics as the song plays.
